questions.use: What public-system use can Arkansas charge for without simply recreating a broad household tax?
questions.depletion: What finite/scarce Arkansas assets are depleted/commercially exploited, and what recurring public income can be captured before value leaves?

count_rule: Only final incremental_recurring_usd_countable may be considered against the ~$7.23B burden. Already-spent streams cannot be counted twice.

bound_scale_summary.gr_line_vs_full_gas_note: GR severance line ($10.6M) understates full gas severance (~$25.6M) because ~95% is highway special revenue

use_candidates.name: Motor fuel tax (gasoline/diesel + related)

addressable_base.source: DFA Motor Fuel Tax Section — Total Receipts by Fiscal Year; gclpefFY2024_2029

use_candidates.current_rate_or_structure: Per-gallon motor fuel / distillate excise structure (Highway Revenue Distribution Law)
use_candidates.already_spent_note: Special revenue for highways/transport — cannot double-count toward IIT/property Tax Retirement Fund
use_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: Rate/index changes or heavy-vehicle differential require statute; EV road-use fee redesign possible but currently small and highway-tied
use_candidates.gross_revenue_note: ~$572M FY2026 bound — material Use scale, already dedicated
use_candidates.behavioral_response: Fuel efficiency / EV shift erodes gallons; demand somewhat inelastic short-run
use_candidates.local_community_share: Via Highway Revenue Distribution (cities/counties/state aid formulas)
use_candidates.volatility: MODERATE — gallons stable vs severance; EV transition medium-run risk
use_candidates.stress_case: Deep recession or rapid EV adoption reduces gallons; fee redesign needed
use_candidates.constitutional_legal_status: Generally applicable user excise; proportional to road use if gallons≈use (weakening with EVs)
use_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Strong use-proportionality vs homeownership tax; fails replacement test because already spent and must stay with roads unless new incremental yield designed
use_candidates.sub_bucket_note: SUPPORT_ENGINE — keep for roads; do not raid for IIT replacement

use_candidates.name: Heavy-vehicle / IFTA / interstate user charges

addressable_base.note: BLR May FY2026 special revenue line; full ESAL/VMT freight base NEE

use_candidates.current_rate_or_structure: IFTA / interstate motor fuel user charges; trip permits; related highway fees
use_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: Weight-distance / ESAL-based heavy truck fee would need statute + Commerce Clause-compliant design
use_candidates.gross_revenue_note: Bound interstate line is small vs fuel total; incremental headroom UNMODELED
use_candidates.collection_admin_cost: IFTA exists; new weight-distance would raise admin/compliance cost
use_candidates.behavioral_response: Route diversion / border shopping if non-harmonized
use_candidates.stress_case: Freight recession; trucking opposition; legal challenge if discriminatory
use_candidates.constitutional_legal_status: Must be generally applicable / not unduly burden interstate commerce
use_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Best Use alignment (cost-imposed by heavy trucks) — needs ESAL model before any count

use_candidates.name: Electric/hybrid vehicle registration fee
use_candidates.current_rate_or_structure: Flat EV/hybrid registration fee (highway special revenue)
use_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: Mileage-based user fee pilots — legal/admin pending
use_candidates.behavioral_response: Minor effect on EV adoption at current scale
use_candidates.volatility: Grows with EV fleet; still small
use_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Philosophically aligned as gallons erode; scale negligible for replacement burden

use_candidates.name: Airport / aviation use charges

addressable_base.note: FAA/airport authority revenues not statewide-bound this slice

use_candidates.already_spent_note: Typically pledged to airport enterprise / federal PFC rules
use_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: Limited state capture without conflicting federal airport grant assurances
use_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Use-aligned but likely not a state Tax Retirement Fund engine

use_candidates.name: Ports / intermodal facility use
use_candidates.already_spent_note: Unknown without authority financials — treat as not free GR
use_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: State participation / ground lease returns (overlaps Enterprise/Value Capture)
use_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Use-aligned; scale unknown; better as Enterprise/External Income participation

use_candidates.name: Water / waste system use charges
use_candidates.already_spent_note: Enterprise funds support system O&M/debt — not IIT replacement
use_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: State industrial water withdrawal fee (see DEPLETION-WATER)
use_candidates.gross_revenue_note: Household water/waste rate hikes would recreate broad household burden — reject as IIT swap
use_candidates.behavioral_response: Conservation; affordability crisis if raised broadly
use_candidates.stress_case: Regressive incidence if used as replacement tax
use_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: FAILS replacement design if it taxes ordinary household existence-adjacent services

use_candidates.name: Specialized permitting / regulatory use fees
use_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: Full-cost recovery where underpriced — incremental only after cost study
use_candidates.gross_revenue_note: Typically not material at statewide replacement scale
use_candidates.constitutional_legal_status: Fee must reasonably relate to service/cost
use_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: OK for cost recovery; not a $7B engine

use_candidates.name: Recreation / parks / tourism infrastructure use
use_candidates.current_rate_or_structure: 2% Parks & Tourism tax; park entry/permits; local hospitality
use_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: Destination fees / park premium permits — demand elasticity required

depletion_candidates.name: Natural gas severance tax (full collections, not GR line only)

addressable_base.note: Price $3/Mcf is ILLUSTRATIVE for sensitivity only — not a DFA bind

depletion_candidates.current_rate_or_structure: 1.25% / 1.5% / 5% of market value by well class (A.C.A. § 26-58-111)
depletion_candidates.already_spent_note: ~95% Highway Revenue Distribution special revenue; ~5% GR (~$1.28M of FY26). GR table $10.6M is NOT the full gas severance story.

legally_plausible_alternative.rate_structure: Raise preferential classes toward 5% or add permanent-fund surcharge on NEW production
legally_plausible_alternative.count_status: NOT COUNTED — hypothetical; dedication still highway-dominated unless statute redesigns NEW increment to Prosperity Fund

depletion_candidates.gross_revenue_note: FY2026 gross $25,615,616; highway portion ~$24,334,835; GR portion ~$1,280,781
depletion_candidates.behavioral_response: Drilling/production response to rate; high-cost well incentives matter
depletion_candidates.local_community_share: Indirect via highway aid; not a community permanent share today
depletion_candidates.stress_case: Commodity price crash (observed); cannot underwrite IIT retirement
depletion_candidates.constitutional_legal_status: Generally applicable severance; Commerce Clause OK if non-discriminatory; rededicating highway share has statutory/political constraints
depletion_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Correct depletion instrument, wrong scale/stability/dedication for IIT replacement; support/highway engine

depletion_candidates.name: Oil severance / oil revenues
depletion_candidates.current_rate_or_structure: 4–5% of market value + per-barrel assessments (A.C.A. § 26-58-111 et seq.)
depletion_candidates.already_spent_note: Distributed under oil severance statutes (GR + county aid pathways) — treat as committed
depletion_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: Rate redesign / permanent-fund carve-out on incremental — UNMODELED
depletion_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Legitimate depletion tax; not material for $7.23B

depletion_candidates.name: Brine / lithium — severance + private royalty + permanent-fund share (design)

addressable_base.note: 2.5% royalty is primarily to private brine rights owners — NOT automatic state public income

depletion_candidates.current_rate_or_structure: Brine severance $2.45/1000 bbl; OGC 2.5% LCE royalty to owners; brine acreage fees (~$65/acre class)
depletion_candidates.already_spent_note: No material commercial lithium public cash flow yet; future brine severance may be small vs private royalties

legally_plausible_alternative.private_royalty_illustrative_literature_: tens of millions to brine owners across projects — NOT state GR

depletion_candidates.gross_revenue_note: State COUNTABLE public income still $0 until production + statutory statute/ownership path
depletion_candidates.behavioral_response: Royalty/severance levels affect project FID; race-to-bottom risk vs other jurisdictions
depletion_candidates.local_community_share: Critical design variable — many brine rights held by non-local owners
depletion_candidates.state_share: Currently weak relative to private royalties unless redesigned
depletion_candidates.stress_case: Delayed FID; price crash; leakage of royalties out of state
depletion_candidates.constitutional_legal_status: Severance generally OK; public permanent-fund share needs statute; no export-discriminatory tax
depletion_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Best long-run Depletion opportunity — convert finite lithium into permanent Arkansas wealth; not countable until cash flows exist

depletion_candidates.name: Other minerals (default 5% FMV severance class)
depletion_candidates.current_rate_or_structure: Generally 5% of fair market value at severance for unspecified natural resources
depletion_candidates.already_spent_note: Unknown split without DFA mineral breakout
depletion_candidates.gross_revenue_note: UNMODELED — likely not material vs gas/oil historically
depletion_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Needs production inventory before any claim

depletion_candidates.name: Timber severance
depletion_candidates.already_spent_note: Distribution NEE this slice — assume committed until proven otherwise
depletion_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Renewable vs finite debate; public-land lease returns may matter more than severance nickels

depletion_candidates.name: Public land / resource leases & concessions

addressable_base.note: State parks, wildlife, land commission, school lands inventories needed

depletion_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: Market-rate leases + Prosperity Fund carve-out on new concessions

depletion_candidates.name: Industrial-scale water withdrawal / consumptive use

addressable_base.note: Critical for brine/lithium and large industry; no statewide fee series bound

depletion_candidates.current_rate_or_structure: Limited statewide pricing of scarce water as public resource
depletion_candidates.already_spent_note: No major statewide industrial water royalty bound
depletion_candidates.legally_plausible_alternative: Consumptive-use fee / aquifer impact payment with community + permanent-fund shares
depletion_candidates.proportionality_or_depletion_test: Scarce-resource rent; not household water rates

COUNTABLE_NOW.verdict: EMPTY — no evidence-backed incremental, legally free, reserved cash flow cleared this pass

PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNMODELED_LEGAL_PENDING.verdict: Heavy-vehicle ESAL fees; airport/port participation; lithium permanent-fund/public share; other minerals; timber; public-land leases; industrial water rents

NOT_MATERIAL_AS_REPLACEMENT_ENGINE.verdict: Motor fuel (~$572M) and gas/oil severance are real but already spent and/or too volatile/small to carry ~$7.23B; household water/waste and tiny EV fees unsuitable as replacement engines

engine_role_verdict.USE: SUPPORT ENGINE — large existing road-use base (~$0.57B) must stay with transportation; incremental replacement capacity not proven
engine_role_verdict.DEPLETION: SUPPORT / FUTURE OPTION — full gas severance ~$26M (volatile; mostly highways); lithium could matter after 2028+ if public permanent share designed; not countable now
